experiences.name: Istrian Hill Towns
experiences.description: From Rovinj inland through Svetvinčenat and Pazin to Buzet, Motovun and Grožnjan, the classic chain of Istrian hill towns. Small roads between truffle forests and vineyards, with a stone village at every turn.

experiences.name: Istria West Coast
experiences.description: From the Roman amphitheatre in Pula up the west coast to Rovinj and Poreč. Easy riding through olive groves and pine woods with sea views, good for a relaxed coastal day.

sights.name: Borcima narodnooslobodilačke borbe i žrtvama fašizma 1941-1945

experiences.name: Opatija Riviera to Labin
experiences.description: Leave Rijeka along the Kvarner Riviera through Opatija, Lovran and Mošćenička Draga, with the Učka massif above you, then follow the coast south to Plomin and up to Labin.

sights.name: crkva svetog Romualda i Svih Svetih
Pomorski i povijesni musej hrvatskog primorja Rijeka
Interpretacijski centar ribarske i pomorske baštine Kuća od mora

experiences.name: Krk Island by the Bridge
experiences.description: Cross the Krk Bridge from the mainland, ride down the west side of the island past Malinska and across the island road to Baška at its southern end. No ferry needed, and fine views across to Cres and Prvić.

sights.name: crkva svetog Romualda i Svih Svetih
Roman Forum at Fulfinum, Mirine, Omišalj

experiences.name: Gorski Kotar and the Lujzijana
experiences.description: The old Louisiana Road from Karlovac through the forests of Gorski Kotar via Vrbovsko, Skrad and Delnice, ending with the descent to the sea at Rijeka. Fast flowing curves under tall beech and spruce.

sights.name: crkva svetog Romualda i Svih Svetih

experiences.name: Magistrala: Rijeka to Zadar
experiences.description: The Adriatic Highway at its wildest: the bare Velebit coast through Senj, Karlobag and Starigrad Paklenica, with the islands lined up offshore. Long and exposed, with wind and bora to watch.

sights.name: crkva Bezgrešnog Začeća Blažene Djevice Marije

experiences.name: Magistrala: Zadar to Split
experiences.description: The middle of the Dalmatian coast: Zadar, the old town of Šibenik, UNESCO-listed Trogir and on to Split. More towns and traffic than the northern Magistrala, but the stops are the point.

sights.name: don Marko Sikirić župnik i domoljub

experiences.name: Magistrala: Split to Dubrovnik
experiences.description: Down the Makarska Riviera under the Biokovo wall, across the Neretva delta and the Pelješac Bridge, past the walls of Ston to Dubrovnik. The bridge replaces the Bosnian corridor at Neum, so the whole ride stays in Croatia.

experiences.name: Majstorska Road and the Zrmanja
experiences.description: From Gospić to Sveti Rok, then over the Velebit on the historic Majstorska cesta, a macadam road of about 40 km that crosses the ridge at Mali Alan and is partly unpaved, down to Obrovac and along the Zrmanja river to Gračac. Dual-sport or adventure bike territory; the surface changes often.

sights.name: Ostaci željezničkog nasipa iz filma Winnetou

experiences.name: Lika Heartland to Zadar
experiences.description: A long day through inland Croatia: Slunj, the Plitvice Lakes, the Lika plateau at Udbina and Gračac and the descent to the Adriatic at Zadar. Open country, little traffic and big sky.

sights.name: Hram Sv. Arhanđela Mihaila i Gavrila
crkva Bezgrešnog Začeća Blažene Djevice Marije

experiences.name: Biokovo Coast to Imotski
experiences.description: Leave Omiš on the Magistrala past Brela and Baška Voda, then turn inland over the Zagvozd pass to Imotski, between the Biokovo massif and the karst polje. From sea level to dry Dalmatian hinterland in a short morning.

sights.name: paragliding take off site, Miletin Bor, 650 m

experiences.name: Sinj and Vrlika to Knin
experiences.description: From Split past the Klis fortress to Sinj, Vrlika and the Cetina plateau, finishing at Knin beneath its great fortress. Open Dalmatian hinterland, with good surfaces and light traffic.

experiences.name: Zagorje Castles
experiences.description: From Zagreb through the green hills of Hrvatsko Zagorje, past Marija Bistrica and Krapina and along the Bednja valley, with Trakošćan Castle a short detour off the road, on to baroque Varaždin. Winding hill roads, castles and small wine villages.

sights.name: crkva svetog Ivana apostola i evanđelista

experiences.name: Slavonia and the Danube
experiences.description: Flat Slavonia at its best: Đakovo and its cathedral, the baroque centre of Osijek, then Vukovar and the Danube road to Ilok. Easy, fast roads for a rest day and a lot of history.

experiences.name: Papuk Wine Hills to Osijek
experiences.description: Leave Požega for the Kutjevo wine country, skirt the Papuk hills at Orahovica and Našice and ride on to Osijek. Rolling wooded roads in one of Croatia's least-visited regions.

sights.name: Muzej školjaka i vodenog svijeta Osijek
